data.title: Unit 7: Heat, light, and sound
Temperature
data.text: Click the correct option to say whether these sentences are right or wrong.
The temperature at which water freezes is 0°C.
The Kelvin scale is used to measure extremely cold and extremely hot temperatures.
The two main scales for measuring temperature are Celsius and Fahrenheit.
On the Celsius scale, water freezes at 32° and boils at 212°.
The slower the molecules move, the higher is the temperature.
